name: mifkada
description: מפקדה - מרכז שליטה מקומי לסשני Claude Code

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,app -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w web" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.dev:app: wait-on -t 90000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4778 http-get://127.0.0.1:4777/api/health && npm run build:desktop && MIFKADA_DEV=1 env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.app: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --mac --dir -c.mac.identity=null && codesign --force --deep --sign - release/mac-arm64/Mifkada.app
scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/no-run-as-node.mjs electron .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.install:app: npm run app && (osascript -e 'quit app "Mifkada"' || true) && rm -rf /Applications/Mifkada.app && ditto release/mac-arm64/Mifkada.app /Applications/Mifkada.app && open /Applications/Mifkada.app
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.hot: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.app:linux: npm run build && node scripts/no-run-as-node.mjs electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.app:win: npm run build && node scripts/no-run-as-node.mjs electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && node scripts/no-run-as-node.mjs electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.release:linux: npm run build && node scripts/no-run-as-node.mjs electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && node scripts/no-run-as-node.mjs electron-builder --win nsis --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: מפקדה משתמשת במיקרופון כדי להמיר דיבור לטקסט מקומית במחשב
